reason: A is better aligned with exhaust catalysis: oxidation-driven Ce segregation and ceria formation could plausibly provide oxygen-storage/redox functionality and inhibit sintering without adding PGM, and it is directly testable against an untreated control under H2O/NO aging. B improperly transfers an electrochemical methanol-oxidation mechanism involving OH−, CO poisoning, and overpotential to gas-phase automotive exhaust, while its cited evidence does not support resistance to thermal sintering or mileage-related degradation.
